title: Support and tools.
intro: Simple resources and educational content to accompany you through your process. Soma does not replace professional care.
quote: Asking for support is also a form of strength.

tools.title: Quick tools
tools.subtitle: Short exercises to use at your own pace.

breathing.title: Guided breathing
breathing.body: A visual guide to pace your breathing, without holding your breath.
breathing.rhythm: Suggested pace: breathe in for 4 s and out for 6 s.
breathing.notice: Breathe at your own pace. If you feel dizzy or uncomfortable, stop.

mindfulness.title: Mindfulness
mindfulness.body: Short pauses to come back to the present moment.

movement.title: Physical activation
movement.body: Gentle movement ideas for everyday life.

craving.title: Managing cravings
craving.body: Resources for riding out the urge to use.

learn.title: Learning resources
learn.subtitle: Educational articles already published in Explore.

processes.title: Key processes
processes.caption: How the body adapts to substance use.

help.title: If you need help now
help.subtitle: Guidance for difficult moments.
help.educational: Soma is an educational resource. It does not provide professional assistance or emergency care.
help.emergency: If your life or someone else's is in immediate danger, contact the emergency services where you are.
help.professional: For personalised guidance, talk to a healthcare professional.
help.thirdParty: The links and phone numbers below belong to external services. Soma does not run those services and does not guarantee their availability or response.
help.termsLink: Read the section on situations that need professional help
help.otherEmergency: If there is immediate danger, contact local emergency services where you are. Soma does not provide an international emergency number.

coverage.empty: Select a coverage to see verified official resources.
